physics-killer-05.title: Wanti massii $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ qabu
physics-killer-05.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-05.material: Wanti massii $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ qabu kallattii $+x$ tiin $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ tiin socho'aa jira. Wanta kana irratti humni kallattii $+x$ hojjeta; hammi humnaa yeroo $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti $0$ irraa $40\,\mathrm{N}$ tti walfakkaataan dabala, yeroo $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti $40\,\mathrm{N}$ irratti dhaabbata, yeroo $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti $40\,\mathrm{N}$ irraa $0$ tti walfakkaataan hir'ata. Humni kun hojjetuu $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti hammi impulse wanti sun fudhate fi saffisni wantichaa humni sun dhabamee battaluma booda hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami? (Humni biraa hin jiru.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.prompt: Wanti massii $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ qabu kallattii $+x$ tiin $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ tiin socho'aa jira. Wanta kana irratti humni kallattii $+x$ hojjeta; hammi humnaa yeroo $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti $0$ irraa $40\,\mathrm{N}$ tti walfakkaataan dabala, yeroo $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti $40\,\mathrm{N}$ irratti dhaabbata, yeroo $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti $40\,\mathrm{N}$ irraa $0$ tti walfakkaataan hir'ata. Humni kun hojjetuu $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti hammi impulse wanti sun fudhate fi saffisni wantichaa humni sun dhabamee battaluma booda hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami? (Humni biraa hin jiru.)
physics-killer-05.s.s1.explain: Bal'ina: sadii jalqabaa $\frac12\cdot0.1\cdot40=2$, kuwwaa $0.2\cdot40=8$, sadii dhumaa $2$; kanaaf $I=12\,\mathrm{N\cdot s}$. $I=m(v-v_0)$ irraa $12=2(v-4)\Rightarrow v=10\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Hundumaa kuwwaa $40\cdot0.4=16$ yoo fudhatan deebii dogoggoraa ②, kutaa sadii yoo dhiisan $8$ deebii dogoggoraa ③, $I$ massiidhaan yoo hin qoodin $4+12=16$ deebii dogoggoraa ④ ta'a.

physics-killer-05.steps.0.prompt: Wanti massii $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ qabu kallattii $+x$ tiin $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ tiin socho'aa jira. Wanta kana irratti humni kallattii $+x$ hojjeta; hammi humnaa yeroo $0\sim0.1\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti $0$ irraa $40\,\mathrm{N}$ tti walfakkaataan dabala, yeroo $0.1\sim0.3\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti $40\,\mathrm{N}$ irratti dhaabbata, yeroo $0.3\sim0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti $40\,\mathrm{N}$ irraa $0$ tti walfakkaataan hir'ata. Humni kun hojjetuu $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ keessatti hammi impulse wanti sun fudhate fi saffisni wantichaa humni sun dhabamee battaluma booda hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami? (Humni biraa hin jiru.)
physics-killer-05.steps.0.explain: Bal'ina: sadii jalqabaa $\frac12\cdot0.1\cdot40=2$, kuwwaa $0.2\cdot40=8$, sadii dhumaa $2$; kanaaf $I=12\,\mathrm{N\cdot s}$. $I=m(v-v_0)$ irraa $12=2(v-4)\Rightarrow v=10\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Hundumaa kuwwaa $40\cdot0.4=16$ yoo fudhatan deebii dogoggoraa ②, kutaa sadii yoo dhiisan $8$ deebii dogoggoraa ③, $I$ massiidhaan yoo hin qoodin $4+12=16$ deebii dogoggoraa ④ ta'a.
